blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Plastic Flow refers to the internal deformation of glacier ice occurring under pressure.
Basal Slip involves the physical sliding of a glacier over bedrock, assisted by meltwater.
Glacial flow velocity is non-uniform across the body, moving faster at the center than at the sides.
Distinguish between Plastic Flow (internal pressure deformation) and Basal Slip (bedrock sliding aided by meltwater).
Note for spatial questions: Glacial velocity is higher at the center than at the edges due to friction against side walls.
